metadata.title: Universal Ichor and Covenant Power
metadata.purpose: Shared fictional Ichor substance rules, Bounty Ichor economy, Resonance, Divine Claim, item instability, and safety boundaries.

safety.rule: Ichor is a fictional tabletop substance. This dataset contains no real-world chemistry, weapon-building, electronics, or medical instructions.

item_tags.source: Deity or prison system that produced it.

load.meaning: Strain placed on a user or system.

item_tags.appetite: A short statement of the behavior encouraged or price sought.

instability.recovery: Repair clears Instability; resting alone does not.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: proficiency bonus + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: proficiency bonus + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

divine_relationship.class_covenant: Each class has one canonical deity because that deity supplies the class's Bounty Ichor and covenant pressure.
divine_relationship.worship_is_broader: A character may honor, fear, reject, bargain with, study, or oppose any deity.
divine_relationship.agency: Even at maximum Divine Claim, a deity cannot choose the character's action.
